questions.question: What does God require of Israel, according to Moses?
options: To fear him, walk in his ways, and love and serve him
To conquer all the nations and take their land
To offer many sacrifices at the altar every day
To gather up great wealth and store it all up
questions.answer: To fear him, walk in his ways, and love and serve him

questions.question: What did God command about the foreigner, orphan, and widow?
options: To give them refuge only within the gates of the cities
To love the foreigner and do justice for orphan and widow
To set apart a tithe every third year to meet their needs
To leave gleanings in the fields for them at each harvest
questions.answer: To love the foreigner and do justice for orphan and widow

questions.question: Moses placed the new tablets in the ark.
God asks Israel to fear him, walk in his ways, love him, and _____ the LORD with all the heart.
God loves the foreigner; so Israel too was to love the _____.
